text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking first place once again at Tokyo 
Racecourse, where she also won the Derby, 
Eishin Flash bows to express her respect 
to her parents and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her parents rejoiced greatly at her 
victory, showing their deep respect with 
the words, "We are so proud of you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, her goal was achieved. Sharing 
her burning spirit as she geared up for 
her final "Arima Kinen"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding onto the hope that she would keep 
running, they set about building her 
schedule for after the Arima Kinen.
